create_VisionTransformer: create a VisionTransformer model with configurable patch size, embed dim, depth, and number of heads
build_vit_base_model: build a vit_base model with 768 embed dim, 12 layers, and 12 attention heads
build_vit_large_video_model: build a vit_large model for video input with multiple frames and tubelet size
build_vit_giant_rope_model: build a vit_giant_rope model with rotary positional embeddings and 40 layers
summarize_VIT_EMBED_DIMS: summarize the VIT_EMBED_DIMS mapping of model names to their embedding dimensions
